newsitem.title: USA: WCI says 5 mln shrs tendered to WCI Holding.
newsitem.headline: WCI says 5 mln shrs tendered to WCI Holding.

text.p: WCI Steel Inc said on Wednesday that WCI Steel Holdings Inc's offer to buy all the outstanding WCI shares had expired, and that WCI Steel Holdings met the public acceptance condition to the offer.

The company said 5,397,623 shares were tendered, or about 95.46 percent of the total number of shares not owned by WCI Steel Holdings, including 6,550 shares subject to guarantees of delivery or receipt of additional documentation.
The public acceptance condition required that at least 2,770,576 public shares be tendered in the offer, WCI said.

The offer was expected to close on Wednesday. Afterwards, WCI would have a total of 36.4 million shares outstanding, 99.29 percent, or 36,144,523 shares, of which would be owned by WCI Steel Holdings, the company said.

As previously announced, WCI said any shares not tendered under the WCI Steel Holdings offer would be acquired in a "short form" merger of WCI Steel Holdings with and into WCI, with WCI continuing as the surviving corporation. This was also expected to be effected today, the company said.
After the merger, WCI would be a unit of The Renco Group, which in October offered to buy all WCI shares it did not already own for $10 per share cash, then take WCI private.
This tender offer was conditioned upon sufficient shares being tendered so WCI Steel Holdings would own at least 90 percent of WCI's common stock, it said.
